Package eu.algites.lib.factory.cpdiscovery

Class AIsCategoryProviderDiscovery

java.lang.Object
eu.algites.lib.factory.cpdiscovery.AIsCategoryProviderDiscovery
public final class AIsCategoryProviderDiscovery extends Object
Entry point for resolving annotation-declared provider factories through a single explicitly configured, or service-discovered, AIiCategoryProviderRegistry. The registry owns ClassLoader/ModuleLayer registration and its immutable snapshots; this utility never instantiates resolver implementation classes reflectively.

  • Method Details

    • setRegistry

      public static void setRegistry(AIiCategoryProviderRegistry aRegistry)
      Installs the application-scoped registry, for instance after registering the desired module layers or classloaders. A null value clears the override and permits service discovery. Callers should install it during startup before resolving field metadata.
      Parameters:
      aRegistry - application registry, or null to restore service lookup

    • getRegistry

      public static AIiCategoryProviderRegistry getRegistry()
      Returns the application registry; when none is explicitly installed, discovers one through ServiceLoader and registers the current context classloader as a factory scope. An absent or ambiguous registry fails explicitly instead of silently ignoring resolvers.
      Returns:
      selected registry
      Throws:
      AIxCategoryProviderUnavailableException - if no registry implementation is available
      AIxCategoryProviderConflictException - if more than one registry is discovered

    • getInstance

      public static <I, C> I getInstance(AIaCategoryProviderFactoryDefinition aDefinition, Class<? extends AIiCategoryProviderFactory<I,C>> aRequiredFactoryType, String aDefaultCategory, C aContext)
      Creates an implementation using the annotation-defined specialized factory and the registry's category/provider resolution. The caller determines the default category and supplies a context understood by the specialized factory SPI.
      Type Parameters:
      I - returned implementation type
      C - factory context type
      Parameters:
      aDefinition - selection attached to the annotation member
      aRequiredFactoryType - expected specialized factory SPI
      aDefaultCategory - category used when the annotation category is empty
      aContext - factory context
      Returns:
      implementation selected by CPDiscovery
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the annotation selects an incompatible factory SPI
